indexdef: CREATE INDEX conversions_chargeback_account_time_idx ON public.conversions USING btree (workspace_id, platform, processor_account_id, ledger_type, occurred_at) WHERE (ledger_type = ANY (ARRAY['chargeback'::text, 'chargeback_fee'::text, 'chargeback_reversal'::text, 'chargeback_fee_reversal'::text]))

CREATE INDEX conversions_chargeback_dispute_idx ON public.conversions USING btree (workspace_id, platform, processor_account_id, dispute_id) WHERE ((dispute_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ledger_type = ANY (ARRAY['chargeback'::text, 'chargeback_fee'::text, 'chargeback_reversal'::text, 'chargeback_fee_reversal'::text])))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversions_chargeback_event_uidx ON public.conversions USING btree (workspace_id, platform, processor_account_id, ledger_type, source_event_id) WHERE ((ledger_type = ANY (ARRAY['chargeback'::text, 'chargeback_fee'::text, 'chargeback_reversal'::text, 'chargeback_fee_reversal'::text])) AND (processor_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_event_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE INDEX conversions_financial_reconciliation_source_idx ON public.conversions USING btree (workspace_id, platform, processor_account_id, source_event_id, ledger_type) WHERE ((source_event_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ledger_type = ANY (ARRAY['refund'::text, 'chargeback'::text, 'chargeback_fee'::text, 'chargeback_reversal'::text, 'chargeback_fee_reversal'::text])))
